title: Greer tells RFK Jr. about the letter at Sundance
summary: Steven Greer tells of Greer tells RFK Jr. about the letter at Sundance, about unspecified at Sundance, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um and I told him just briefly because we were in this crowd, I have a letter from your dad about this UFO issue dated a month before they killed him.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that he once met Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the son of the politician Robert Kennedy, in a crowd at Sundance in Utah. Greer says he briefly told him he had a letter from his father about UFOs, dated a month before, in Greer's words, 'they killed him'. If true, it would tie a famous American political figure to an interest in UFOs shortly before his death.
